description: Retrieve one message attachment through the authenticated, audited OpenTrain attachment read (messages.attachments.get; requires messages:read). Pass the opaque attachmentId (att_ + 32 hex) from opentrain_read_messages, opentrain_audit_job_messages, or opentrain_get_message_thread (attachments[].attachmentId). A verified PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF at or below 4 MiB is returned as an image content block you can look at directly (exact sniffed MIME type + base64 of the verified bytes). Anything else — any non-image, or any image above 4 MiB — is returned as a resource_link to opentrain://messages/{messageId}/attachments/{attachmentId}; read that resource for the verified bytes (≤ 20 MiB, audited). structuredContent.result carries verified metadata only (name, sniffed mimeType, byteSize, sha256, source, delivery, resourceUri, requestId) — never bytes, never a signed URL, storage path, or legacy URL. Missing, foreign, and unknown selectors are ONE opaque 404; deleted/hidden/unavailable attachments are a 409 with a closed reason; 429 carries retry metadata; 503 is retryable.

attachmentId.description: Opaque attachment id (att_ + 32 hex) from a message read, audit, or thread read (attachments[].attachmentId).

messageId.description: Id of a message in a conversation the token can read.

name: opentrain_get_message_attachment
